text: E: (1) In logic, the symbol of the universal negative judgment -- no men are monkeys. (2) In experimental psychology, the symbol of excitation or stimulus; a varying quantity, as ounces of pressure, units of sound, light, &c. (3) E-values (Ger. E - Werthe ). One of the most important of the special symbols of Avenarius' EMPIRIO-CRITICISM (q.v.). Cf. also INTROJECTION. ( J.M.B. )
